text:
mia: flagging an exec-unblock for Cardinal Health pilot. CISO pushed back on data residency language and wants a written EU-only pilot guarantee + pen-test evidence before greenlight. They also called out SSO provisioning and a throughput SLA as blockers. Need owners.
raj: I'll take SSO / provisioning. Quick note: we support SCIM for Okta with basic user/group sync today, but not delegated admin. Can propose a scoped provisioning contract for the pilot. ETA for scope doc: EOD.
ethan: I'll own perf and the SLA. Cardinal asked for 120 req/s sustained and p99 <=250ms for inference endpoints. I need to validate against our jitter under burst. Can someone get me a representative payload set?
luis: I'll draft a short contract addendum for an EU-only pilot commitment (data stored and processed in eu-central-1) and the conditional language legal is comfortable with. We probably need to say "EU-region-only for pilot" rather than broad residency guarantees.
legal-bot: reminder: share the security questionnaire PDF version and state intended recipients. Pen-test reports require NDA and redaction. Put requests into the legal queue with subject line "Cardinal pen-test request".
mia: I'll request sample payloads + exact questionnaire version from the customer. Also asking for point of contact for pen-test artifacts.
raj: If they insist on delegated-admin for SCIM, we should offer a temporary admin-proxy pattern (SE-managed) for the pilot rather than changing IAM. I'll sketch the steps in the scope doc.
ethan: For benchmark runs I can provision a reserved pilot cluster in eu-central for a short window. Need confirmation of test window and a test token. Prefer to run synthetic tonight to surface any tail-latency issues.
luis: Legal note: we can sign a pilot addendum committing to EU processing and logs retention in EU for the duration of the POC. Anything beyond that requires contract review.
ops-bot: ticket created: TICKET-9142 "Cardinal Health POC: EU residency addendum + SCIM + SLA" Assigned to: infra-pilot, sales-oncall.
mia: For pricing ask, Cardinal wants a simple number for a 3-month pilot with either metered usage or a reserved-node option. Can someone build two quick models? Keep the slide to one page.
raj: I'll help with run rate for SCIM ops overhead and any extra SE time.
ethan: I'll put together a perf-cost estimate for reserved nodes vs autoscale to hit 120 rps. Will include an ops runbook for failover and throttling.
luis: Once we have the questionnaire, I'll run a legal pre-check and flag any redlines. Also note: pen-test sharing requires Cardinal to sign our mutual NDA or an addendum.
mia: Tentative exec bridge scheduled for 2025-12-03 10:00 PST. Can internal folks make it? Need SE, perf, and legal.
ethan: I can join.
raj: I can join after 10:15.
luis: I'll be there.
mia: Great. I'll send invites to Priya (CISO), Marco (Head Infra), and Claire (VP Product). Posting updates here as they arrive.
legal-bot: action: create NDA template link: https://confluence.company/ndas/pentest-sharing.
ops-bot: reminder: meeting created 2025-12-03T10:00:00-08:00 (Cardinal Health Exec Bridge).
mia: Closing loop for now 14; will attach questionnaire and payloads once Cardinal responds.
